name: OmaLLDownloader
author: DimDoremy
description: Download activity in the Omarchy bar: how many tasks are running, the total speed, and a popup with each task's progress. Reads `omalld tasks --json`, so it shows the same list the app and the CLI see.

barWidget.description: Download count and speed, with a popup of every task.
